hero.label: Full Stack Developer
hero.tagline: I build and ship real products end to end: React and TypeScript on the frontend, FastAPI and Node.js on the backend, PostgreSQL underneath.
hero.availability: Available for new roles · Buenos Aires, Argentina

about.label: About
about.heading: AI-native, with full ownership of the code.
about.bio1: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience building and launching real products end to end. I work with React and TypeScript on the frontend, and I own Python (FastAPI) and Node.js/Express services on the backend, on top of PostgreSQL with schema design, query optimization and migrations.
about.bio2: AI is a core part of my daily workflow: I write prompts in English, use MCP servers and skills, and build my own agentic workflows with tools like Claude Code, validating the output and integrating results without losing ownership of the code. Proactive by default, used to working in Scrum teams.
